== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Death Star Tractor Beam (Japanese)|Death Star Tractor Beam]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67737 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(2, 5, 461, 634)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>97ad516af979428b561808727e961b4ba8161c8ba0bbccf44046e16c7fc50e2b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
